shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && ls -la && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | grep -v package-lock
cat next.config.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx tsconfig.json; git diff package.json; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && for i in 1 2; do curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '<nav>[^<]*</nav>|Request [0-9a-f-]{36} generated at [^ ]+ \(sample [^)]+\)'; echo ---; done; grep -c '<nav>Operations</nav>' .next/server/app/index.html; pkill -f 'next start' || true

(npx next start -p 3124 > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && for i in 1 2; do curl -s http://localhost:3124/ | grep -oE 'Request [^<]{0,40}<!-- -->[^<]*<!-- -->[^<]*<!-- -->[^<]*<!-- -->[^<]*' | head -1; done; pkill -f 'next start' || true
